question: In Small Cell Lung trials with PD-L1 agents included in the meta-analysis, map the generic ICI name to its brand name.

steps.desc: Filter for Small Cell Lung cancer trials.
Map generic ICI name to brand name, focusing on PD-L1 agents.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Name of ICI and output JSON {NCT, PMID, brand_name}. Focus on PD-L1 inhibitors. Allowed brand_name: ["Atezolizumab", "Avelumab", "Durvalumab", "OTHER/UNKNOWN"]. Hints: atezolizumab -> Atezolizumab, avelumab -> Avelumab, durvalumab -> Durvalumab. JSON only.

steps.desc: Validate label set for brand name and drop invalid rows.
